description: main has no required status checks, so platformAutomerge stays false and Renovate waits for PR checks before merging.

semantic-release releases from commit types, so semanticCommits is enabled instead of detected from recent commits: updates to package.json dependencies commit as fix and release a patch, and other updates commit as chore.
Pi often releases more than once a week, and the footer adapter depends on its internals, so updates are checked daily.

config:best-practices sets the npm release age through security:minimumReleaseAgeNpm. A pin younger than the workflow's --min-release-age fails its resolution check unless the check exempts the package, because npm also resolves the dev dependencies that Pi's Git installation omits.

packageRules.description: Renovate puts major updates on a separate branch, so a failing major does not hold back minor and patch updates.

The Pi host pins its TUI to the same version, and the footer adapter depends on Pi internals. Pi updates wait one day instead of three; the workflow's npm check accepts them because it exempts @earendil-works packages, as Pi's own npmCommand does.
CI tests with the Bun version in packageManager, and @types/bun follows Bun's version numbers.
oxlint and oxfmt ship together from the Oxc repository, and oxfmt minor releases can change formatting.
TypeScript minor releases can add type errors.
semantic-release ships coordinated majors with its plugins, and each plugin major supports only certain conventional-changelog preset majors.
The release test runs commit analysis and release notes in a dry run, but no PR check runs the publishing path of the semantic-release core or GitHub plugin.
